alt.description: Alt text describing the image for accessibility. Absent if none was provided.

width.description: Width of the image in pixels. Absent if unknown.

height.description: Height of the image in pixels. Absent if unknown.

blobCid.description: CID of the saved image blob.

imageUrl.description: CDN URL of the image, resolved server-side from the blob reference.

dominantColor.description: Hex color code of the most dominant color, for placeholder rendering. Absent if unknown.

attribution.description: Optional provenance metadata for an image content item.
